Starts the manifest run, the daemon run, or the operation run.

detaileddescription.para: Any other argument list runs the command line.

The manifest run starts when the first argument names an existing manifest, with at most one toolchain argument after it. The daemon run starts when the first argument is the daemon word and the second argument names an existing file. The operation run starts when the second argument names an existing file and the first argument is not the daemon word. Any other argument list runs the command line, which sets the exit code and quits. On Windows, the console output code page is set to UTF-8. On a terminal, the screen is erased first.

detaileddescription.para: The lock name is the daemon name of the manifest and the toolchain argument. The lock is tried without a wait. When the lock is taken, the function starts the processor and the manifest reading, sets the toolchain argument and the manifest path in the model, and starts the socket server. When the lock is not taken, the application quits.

Its first word is the flag argument as typed, its second word is the working folder, and its other words are the arguments after the manifest and the toolchain argument. The client starts a daemon when no daemon answers, and it prints the reply.

briefdescription.para: The juce::JUCEApplicationBase of the LING command line, started by START_JUCE_APPLICATION.

detaileddescription.para: initialise() starts one of three runs: the manifest run, the daemon run, or the operation run. Any other command line runs the command line, which sets the exit code and quits.

The manifest run writes the toolchain argument and the manifest path to the model. The processor and the manifest reading then parse the files, and the application prints the documents and quits. The daemon run starts the processor, the manifest reading, and the socket server, when it takes the lock of the daemon. The operation run starts a client that sends one request to the daemon.
